name: Tsitsikamma Micro Brewery
description_short: Craft brewery in Storms River serving wood-fired pizzas alongside freshly brewed beers in a relaxed garden setting.
description_long:
Tucked away in the heart of Storms River village, Tsitsikamma Micro Brewery combines handcrafted beers with honest, hearty food. The brewery produces a rotating selection of ales and lagers on-site, from crisp pilsners to rich stouts, all best enjoyed in their spacious beer garden under the trees.

The kitchen focuses on wood-fired pizzas with generous toppings, alongside pub favourites like burgers and platters designed for sharing. It's a popular stop for hikers coming off the Otter Trail or visitors exploring the nearby national park, drawn by the promise of cold beer and a laid-back atmosphere. The outdoor seating makes it ideal for families and groups, with plenty of space for kids to roam while parents sample the latest brew.

Whether you're after a tasting paddle to try the full range or simply a pint with pizza after a day on the trails, this brewery delivers unpretentious local flavour in one of the Garden Route's most scenic villages.
